notes: Hand-labelled gold standard for the three scripted meetings. Evidence refers to script line ids as <meeting>:<line>. 'uncertain' marks requirements whose evidence contains audible hesitation; it is a label on the requirement, not on the speaker. 'status' is the requirement's status at the end of the meeting that raised it: agreed (confirmed or proposed), open_question, deferred, or superseded within the same meeting. Status labels were added after the first benchmark runs.

requirements.statement: Patients can book an appointment online without creating an account, giving only a name, phone number and email.
Patients can choose a practitioner and see that practitioner's available times.
Front-desk staff can block out time slots, for example for staff meetings and leave.
Patients receive an SMS reminder the day before their appointment.
Patients may pay a deposit online when booking (open question).
Patients can cancel online up to 24 hours before the appointment; later cancellations must be made by phone.
Bookings are synchronised automatically to ClinicDesk, the clinic's patient records system.
Booking is fast and easy to use, especially on phones.
Patient information is stored in Australia.
Patients log in to an account so they can see their appointment history.
Patients can book either as a guest or with an optional account; account holders can see their past appointments.
New patients pay a $20 deposit online when booking.
The deposit is refunded only if the patient cancels more than 24 hours before the appointment.
Patients receive an email reminder two days before and an SMS reminder the day before their appointment.
ClinicDesk's API is read-only for appointments.
When a booking is cancelled, the slot is offered to the next patient on a waitlist.
New bookings are exported to ClinicDesk every night as a CSV import.
Available times load in under two seconds on a phone connection.
The app conforms to WCAG 2.2 level AA.
